_scope: Track 1 of the 2026-10-01 plan: Stage 1 (published for Tier 20 as df1b0a66) extended to TIER 40. Same three nodes, same rules: page 1 only in both phases; phase 2 does not re-send a query phase 1 got an answer for and re-sends once a query that got no answer (a SerpAPI 503); a phase 1 with no LinkedIn profile at all closes the search explicitly; the phase-1 record is kept for every tier. Tier 20 behaves exactly as df1b0a66 (asserted case by case in the test). No change to the query texts, the number of phase-1 query variants (Tier 40 keeps 4), Prepare Serp Pages, the SerpAPI node, enrichment, scoring, the threshold or billing.
_why: Two retained Tier-40 runs, both on 2026-09-30/10-01: exec 2040 (HR Business Partner) and exec 2044 (Sales Manager, another organization). Pages 2-5: 22 calls each, 44 in total, 0 delivered candidates (2044 delivered all 13 of its candidates from four page-1 calls). Phase 1 fires 20 calls at once; 7 (2040) and 9 (2044) of them came back as 'Service unavailable' - an HTTP 503 that SerpAPI itself returns when it gives up after ~90 s ('We couldn't get valid results for this search'), not a connection failure and not an n8n timeout; SerpAPI does not bill it. Whether the 20-call burst causes it is unproven (bursts of 2-9 calls lost about 3 of 126 calls; exec 2024's 4-call phase 1 also had one). In 2040 SerpAPI gave up on two page-1 queries ('Partner', 'Human Resources') and neither was ever sent again; in 2044 the bag-of-words page 1 failed and was recovered only because phase 2 happened to repeat it (3 delivered). Tier 20's version of this change was proven live in exec 2048 (2026-10-01 14:28 UTC): 4 SerpAPI calls, all page 1, no repeat, 14 delivered, billed = stored = 14. Pages 2-5 also caused 8 paid EnrichLayer enrichments of profiles found only there (7 in 2040, 1 in 2044), none delivered.
_expectedEffect: Exec 2044 replayed: 29 SerpAPI calls (about 16 billed) -> 4 in phase 1 + 2 in phase 2 (the failed bag-of-words page 1 retried, and the no-AND title query that delivered 7) = 6, with the same four page-1 calls that delivered all 13. Exec 2040 replayed: 29 -> 4 + 4 (two retried page-1 queries, bag-of-words, no-AND title). Delivered candidates lost in the two retained Tier-40 runs: 0 (pages 2-5 delivered none). Tier 40 still cannot reach 40 with ~5-6 distinct queries: raising the count is Stage 2, not this change. A Tier-40 run where SerpAPI answers every phase-1 call: 4 + 1 = 5 calls - for titles whose bag-of-words query equals phase-1 query 4 (e.g. 'Sales Manager'), phase 2 is the no-AND title query alone, so whether phase 2 finds anything rests on that one call.
_notDone: Same limits as Stage 1: page 2-5 health is no longer observed (a sparse probe would be a separate decision); a phase 2 that finds no new profile still ends without a completion (pre-existing); the 'it ' substring in the IT-Support query rule; Stage 2 query measurement. Newly reachable for Tier 40 (already listed for Tier 20): a page-1-only phase 1 whose LinkedIn profiles are ALL on foreign country subdomains passes Merge's zero-profile check, then Filter New URLs empties it and the search ends without a completion (none of the 14 retained runs came close: whenever phase 1 had profiles, at least 6 were kept). Part of the separate empty-chain task. Not yet exercised live on any tier: the phase-2 re-send of a 503'd query and the explicit zero-profile close - watch the first run that has a 503.

So no maxEnrich value is enforced by that node: phase 1 is capped only by Filter New URLs (a Code node) at the tier's maxEnrich, which 4 page-1 calls (at most 40 results) can no longer reach; phase-2 paid enrichment is bounded only by the number of phase-2 calls (now fewer). The Filter New URLs header comment saying the limit resolves to the tier's maxEnrich in phase 1 is wrong. Must be fixed BEFORE Stage 2 adds queries: move the phase-2 cap into Filter New URLs or rewrite the expression.
